positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
From 2020-01 to 2025-06: Engineer / TLM within Google Research. Working on large-scale graph learning and graph-mining algorithms with broad impact across all of Alphabet.

Currently focusing on data curation, deduplication, anonymization and more across billions of multimodal entities for Gemini, Imagen (text to image model), and other LLMs for Google and Deepmind.

From 2017-01 to 2019-12: Engineer / TLM on Google Duplex: An AI system for accomplishing real-world tasks over the phone.

From 2015-01 to 2016-12: Engineer / Infrastructure TL of Relatedness Matrix. Working on structured data ranking projects within Google's Knowledge Engine.

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Distributed-Systems Engineer focusing on the expansion and refinement of Resonate's core data product - a nationwide database of internet user demographics and psychographics. 

- Redesigned and re-implemented the company's user modeling processes, resulting in a ~100x speedup in execution time, improved accuracy, and the ability to update models with greatly reduced engineering pain.

- Designed, implemented, and maintained a data metrics system, allowing anyone in the company to monitor the state of our data.  The information provided by this system was used in guiding terms of contracts with partners, and it allowed our team to diagnose complex quality issues.

- Winner of 1st company hackathon, working in a team of two to rapidly prototype a data access platform to allow others to better understand the company's core data product.

positions.title: Sr. Multi-Discipline Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer and Researcher for the Center for Advanced Aviation System Development (CAASD) - A Federally Funded R&D Center for the FAA and international aviation agencies.

- Conceived and led the development of Datatap, a large-scale data analytics and visualization platform that serves years of flight data to researchers and analysts.  Oversaw the continuous operations of the platform for over one year, leading to the savings of hundreds of analyst hours and the initiation of previously impossible analyses.

- Developed and refined nationwide aviation safety metrics, taking projects from simulation/model development to result validation, visualization, and analyses for FAA safety experts.  Additionally, led the integration of alerting system models into our various tools, allowing other analysts to run their own experiments.

- Principal Investigator of a research team responsible for the design and implementation of large-scale, distributed graph databases for aviation data.

- Used the latest open-source technologies to accomplish the above, including much of the Apache Hadoop stack and related tech (MapReduce, HBase, Avro, Storm, etc.).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched critical safety issues regarding the use of Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) microprocessors and Systems-on-Chips (SoC) within commercial and military aerospace applications.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Intern within ASIC Verification Group.  Developed and maintained simulation environments and testbenches, performed testing coverage analysis, and assisted in RTL debug for HP Blade products.  Projects focused on Serial Attached SCSI (SAS) Expanders and PCI-Express I/O Virtualization chips.
